name: yuen ki chan
text: The owners are extremely nice. Lost my phone on the train and they were very helpful leading up to me able to get my phone back. 10/10 customer service will come back if I ever need their services

name: Amanda
text: Great new hardware store in Getty Square. The staff were very helpful and they had everything I needed.

name: David Michael
text: Super helpful. Helped put items together on the spot for us. Local company that just moved around from the corner so not a new business.

name: Sherry Bobrowsky
text: Best store ever! They are extremely helpful and honest. No more Home Depot for me! A+++

name: Edwin Mejia
text: This local hardware store has been a lifesaver. The guys are always helpful and eager to answer your questions. If you're a local you know how parking is around the area so keep that in mind.

name: Marijo
text: A small hardware store, but I found everything I was looking for, including a key copy.

name: Juan Cotto
text: They are my got to guys if they don't have it they will find it for you.

name: Erik Jacobsen
text: Great guys, really helped me out and went above and beyond for me
